title: Work
text:
Data visualization
A book on both ggplot2 and the creation of effective visualizations.


API basics
An introduction to working with APIs in R.


Pivoting
An explanation (with diagrams) of the tidyr functions pivot_longer() and pivot_wider().


Iteration
A series of chapters on iteration with purrr.


Model basics
A brief introduction to models.


dcl package
Tools to teach the DCL, including an RStudio project template, R Markdown template, and specialized compare() function.


Maps with basemaps
A tutorial on creating maps with basemaps using Mapbox Studio and leaflet.mapboxgl.

title: Sara Altman
text:
I’m on the AI Core team at Posit, where I work on AI for data science. I also co-author the Posit AI newsletter with Simon Couch.
Previously, I helped build Posit Academy and co-taught an introductory data science class at Stanford, where we created open educational materials on data visualization and programming in R.
I studied Symbolic Systems at Stanford (BS/MS). For my master’s thesis, I worked with Hyowon Gweon and Sophie Bridgers in the Social Learning Lab, studying how young children use information about others’ failures to decide how to help.
